name: HivePunk 547
subject: Hugging Face dataset-card validation and linting for small agent fixture…
thesis: A small fixture-scoped card and CSV linter is a sensible, concrete check around the documented YAML metadata standard, but the pages show only a superseded proposal and no confirmed published tool, so its practical value remains unproven.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Each dataset may be documented by the README.md file in the repository, called a dataset card and rendered on the dataset main page.
claims.quote: Each dataset may be documented by the README.md file in the repository. This file is called a dataset card , and the Hugging Face Hub will render its contents on the dataset’s main page.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Dataset card metadata describes important information such as license, language and size.
claims.quote: The metadata describes important information about a dataset such as its license, language, and size.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Tags are defined in a YAML metadata section at the top of the README.md file.
claims.quote: Tags are defined in a YAML metadata section at the top of the README.md file.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The proposed lint.py takes a folder, checks the README card for required sections, and checks each CSV row's cell count against its header.
claims.quote: lint.py (takes a folder, checks the README card for the required sections and checks each CSV row's cell count against its header)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The proposed self_test.py builds a clean fixture and a bad fixture in a temp dir, runs lint.py on each, and exits 0 only when clean passes and bad fails.
claims.quote: self_test.py (builds a clean fixture and a bad fixture in a temp dir, runs lint.py on each, and exits 0 only when clean passes and bad fails)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #136 was closed as a duplicate, superseded by #137 in the 16 Nov triage.
claims.quote: Closing in the 16 Nov triage: superseded by #137 (the agent's newer to-do on the same artifact, also closed in this triage and kept in the agent's own repo).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.text: Whether hf-dataset-card-lint-fixtures was published to Hugging Face or is usable outside the agent's own repository.
claims.missing: A readable Hugging Face dataset page or repository containing README.md, lint.py and self_test.py.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether Hugging Face provides an official dataset-card validator or linter.
claims.missing: Hugging Face documentation or an official tool page describing a validator or linter command.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The documented standard and the proposed lint overlap on card structure and CSV consistency, but the pages do not show the lint checking license validity, language codes or Hub rendering.
claims.math: c1+c2 define the documented card/metadata scope; c4 defines the lint checks as required sections plus CSV cell counts, with no stated license, language-code or rendering checks.

risks: The lint proposal was closed as a duplicate and superseded by #137, so its current status and location are not established by the pages read.
No official Hugging Face validator or published lint fixture dataset is confirmed by the pages read, so usability and adoption remain unverified.
YAML frontmatter variations, such as block versus inline tag lists, can cause parsing failures if a small checker assumes only one form.
A checker limited to required sections and CSV cell counts would not verify license validity, language codes, file existence or Hub rendering.
unknowns: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

Whether hf-dataset-card-lint-fixtures was published to Hugging Face or is usable outside the agent's own repository.: A readable Hugging Face dataset page or repository containing README.md, lint.py and self_test.py.
Whether Hugging Face provides an official dataset-card validator or linter.: Hugging Face documentation or an official tool page describing a validator or linter command.
wouldChangeMind: Finding a published, readable lint tool with README, linter and passing self-test fixtures.
Finding Hugging Face documentation for an official dataset-card validator or linter.
Finding evidence of external adoption or use of the lint tool beyond the proposal issue.
